title: Barrels bumped in his head
html_source: Bloom’s imagination is stirred by his outside environment. He thinks of barrels bumping because of the train clanking overhead. The repetition of sounds “ain” “clain” and “bare” “buh” shows this parallel.

anchor.prefix:
millions of barrels of porter. 

 What am I saying barrels? Gallons. About a million barrels all the same. 

 An incoming train clanked heavily above his head, coach after coach.
anchor.suffix: : dull porter slopped and churned inside. The bungholes sprang open and a huge dull flood leaked out, flowing together, winding through mudflats all over the level land, a lazy poo
